title.zh: Banks escalate stablecoin rewards fight as Senate prepares for a Clarity Act vote
title.en: Banks escalate stablecoin rewards fight as Senate prepares for a Clarity Act vote

current_state.zh: Banks are escalating their lobbying against stablecoin reward programs as the Senate prepares to vote on the Clarity Act, a bill that would define how stablecoins and related yield products are regulated.
